_comment: 'This gets **overpower**' was a SET_FLAG named OVERPOWER. SET_FLAG appends the string to current_turn_effects, and the defend path reads combat.keywords -- nothing anywhere reads a flag by that name, so the keyword was never granted. GAIN is the keyword grant, and effect_types.canonical_keyword title-cases it so it matches the exact 'Overpower' test in engine._defend_step.
